title: Vertical structure of a warm-core eddy
query:
Identify a well-resolved Loop Current eddy in the supplied period and characterize its three-dimensional hydrographic structure relative to surrounding Gulf waters. Quantify the vertical extent of its thermal and salinity anomalies.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
